_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: From-scratch L1I (icache) miss MPKI measurement over SPEC CPU2006 (rate_int + rate_fp), all simpoints. Regenerates the on-path vs off-path L1I miss counts used by plot_l1i_onoff_path_mpki.py: ICACHE_MISS_ONPATH_count + ICACHE_MISS_OFFPATH_count (== ICACHE_MISS_count), divided by Cumulative_Instructions for MPKI. Uses kmhv3 (64 KB / 4-way L1I) with top_simpoint=false so every simpoint contributes to the per-workload weighted MPKI (this full-simpoint coverage is the difference from the top-3 bld_pf/topn experiments). NOTE: this produces the raw scarab stats only; it does NOT reproduce csv/l1i_summary.csv's user/kernel/pollution/geometry-delta decomposition, which comes from a separate post-processing pipeline not in this repo.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: false = run ALL simpoints in 'workloads_db.json' (not just the top 3), so the per-workload weighted L1I MPKI reflects the whole program.
_simulations: SPEC CPU2006 integer + floating-point rate suites (gcc, gobmk, perlbench, ...).
_configurations: baseline = stock kmhv3 (wrong-path fetch enabled, --fetch_off_path_ops default 1), so ICACHE_MISS_OFFPATH_count is populated and the on/off-path split is meaningful. no_offpath = --fetch_off_path_ops 0 disables fetching down mispredicted (off) paths, so the frontend stops at an unresolved branch instead of speculatively fetching wrong-path lines; ICACHE_MISS_OFFPATH_count collapses to ~0 and only on-path L1I misses remain. Comparing the two isolates how much of the L1I miss stream (and its MPKI) is wrong-path-driven.

baseline._params: Stock kmhv3. Wrong-path fetch on (fetch_off_path_ops=1 default). Full on-path + off-path L1I miss stream.

no_offpath._params: --fetch_off_path_ops 0: frontend does not fetch past an unresolved mispredicted branch, so there is no wrong-path icache access. ICACHE_MISS_OFFPATH_count -> ~0; on-path L1I misses only.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
